verses.sloka: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम् ।आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम् ॥४-२७-१॥
verses.transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve praviṣṭe vānare guhām ।ājagāma saha bhrātrā rāmaḥ prasravaṇam girim ॥4-27-1॥

translations.english: After the consecration, Sugriva entered the cavecity (of Kishkinda) and Rama accompanied by his brother reached mountain Prasravana.
translations.hindi: किष्किन्धाकाण्ड का छुब्बीसवां संग पूरा हुआ । सकि हार को पाठान्तरे--व्तिनि, ( .::: = ee —— प्तविश ९ सप्तविशः सगः ¦ —® > अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम्‌ । ` आजमाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्त्रणं गिरिम्‌

verses.sloka: शार्दूल मृग संघुष्टम् सिंहैः भीम रवैः वृतम् ।नाना गुल्म लता गूढम् बहु पादप संकुलम् ॥४-२७-२॥
verses.transliteration: śārdūla mṛga saṁghuṣṭam siṁhaiḥ bhīma ravaiḥ vṛtam ।nānā gulma latā gūḍham bahu pādapa saṁkulam ॥4-27-2॥

translations.english: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.
translations.hindi: त शार्दूल ओर मर्गो आ था ओर बह्‌ प्रखबण पर्वत शार्दूल और मगो से भरा हुआ भयङ्कर सिंह उस पर दहाडा करते थे । अनेक प्रकार की माड़ि लदाओं और वृक्षों से वह भरा पूरा था

verses.sloka: ऋक्ष वानर गोपुच्छैः मार्जारैः च निषेवितम् ।मेघ राशि निभम् शैलम् नित्यम् शुचिकरम् शिवम् ॥४-२७-३॥
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣa vānara gopucchaiḥ mārjāraiḥ ca niṣevitam ।megha rāśi nibham śailam nityam śucikaram śivam ॥4-27-3॥

translations.english: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.
translations.hindi: उस पर रीळ बंदर गोपुच्छ बनबिलाव रहा करते थे। वह भेघाडम्बर की तरह देख पड़ता था । उस पर जो पानी के मरने जे उनका जल सदा साफ रहता था

verses.sloka: तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे महतीम् आयताम् गुहाम् ।प्रत्यगृह्णीत वासार्थम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ॥४-२७-४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya śailasya śikhare mahatīm āyatām guhām ।pratyagṛhṇīta vāsārtham rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ॥4-27-4॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana decided to reside in the long, wide cave on top of the great mountain.

verses.sloka: कृत्वा च समयम् रामः सुग्रीवेण सह अनघ ।काल युक्तम् महद् वाक्यम् उवाच रघुनन्दन ॥४-२७-५॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā ca samayam rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa saha anagha ।kāla yuktam mahad vākyam uvāca raghunandana ॥4-27-5॥

translations.english: Sinless Rama, the delight of the Raghus made an agreement with Sugriva and then spoke appropriately to Lakshmana, his obedient brother and enhancer of glory:
translations.hindi: अनघ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सुग्रीव के साथ पवेत पर रहने की “अबधि निश्चित कर, श्री के बढ़ाने वाले एवं विनीत भाई लच्मण ज्ञो से समयानुकूल बचन कहे । (वे बोले) हे लक्ष्मए ! यह पर्वत की कन्दरा बड़ी मनोहर, लंबी चोड़ो ओर हवादार है

verses.sloka: विनीतम् भ्रातरम् भ्राता लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि वर्धनम् ।इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता ॥४-२७-६॥
verses.transliteration: vinītam bhrātaram bhrātā lakṣmaṇam lakṣmi vardhanam ।iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā ॥4-27-6॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri, subduer of enemies this beautiful mountain cave is spacious and adequately ventilated. We will reside here in the rainy season.
translations.hindi: i} विविधैट्ट क्षषण्डश्च चारुचित्रलताट्टतम्‌ । चानाविहगसंघुष्ट मधूररवनादितम्‌ ॥&॥ '' , यह अनेक वक्त समूहों और मनोहर विचित्र लताओं से चिरा हुआ, नाना पक्षियों से युक्त और मोरों के शब्द से शब्दाय- आत है

verses.sloka: अस्याम् वस्त्याम सौमित्रे वर्ष रात्रम् अरिंदम ।गिरि शृंगम् इदम् रम्यम् उत्तमम् पार्थिवात्मज ॥४-२७-७॥
verses.transliteration: asyām vastyāma saumitre varṣa rātram ariṁdama ।giri śṛṁgam idam ramyam uttamam pārthivātmaja ॥4-27-7॥

translations.english: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.

verses.sloka: श्वेताभिः कृष्ण ताम्राभिः शिलाभिः उपशोभितम् ।नाना धातु समाकीर्णम् नदी दर्दुर संयुतम् ॥४-२७-८॥
verses.transliteration: śvetābhiḥ kṛṣṇa tāmrābhiḥ śilābhiḥ upaśobhitam ।nānā dhātu samākīrṇam nadī dardura saṁyutam ॥4-27-8॥

translations.english: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.
translations.hindi: थह सफेद, काली और लाल रंग की शिलाओं से शोभित ओर नाना घातुओं से चित्रित हे और जल के झरनें तथा गुफाओं से भी शोभित हैं

verses.sloka: विविधैः वृक्ष षण्डैः च चारु चित्र लता युतम् ।नाना विहग संघुष्टम् मयूर वर नादितम् ॥४-२७-९॥
verses.transliteration: vividhaiḥ vṛkṣa ṣaṇḍaiḥ ca cāru citra latā yutam ।nānā vihaga saṁghuṣṭam mayūra vara nāditam ॥4-27-9॥

translations.english: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.

verses.sloka: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च सिंदुवारैः शिरीषकैः ।कदंब अर्जुन सर्जैः च पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम् ॥४-२७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: mālatī kuṁda gulmaiḥ ca siṁduvāraiḥ śirīṣakaiḥ ।kadaṁba arjuna sarjaiḥ ca puṣpitaiḥ upaśobhitam ॥4-27-10॥

translations.english: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.

verses.sloka: इयम् च नलिनि रम्या फुल्ल पंकज मण्डितैः ।न अति दूरे गुहाया नौ भविष्यति नृपात्मज ॥४-२७-११॥
verses.transliteration: iyam ca nalini ramyā phulla paṁkaja maṇḍitaiḥ ।na ati dūre guhāyā nau bhaviṣyati nṛpātmaja ॥4-27-11॥

translations.english: 'O prince this pond with lotus creeper and lotuses in full bloom is endearing. It is located not far from the cave.
translations.hindi: हे राजकुमार ! खिले हुए कमल के फूलों से भूषित नंदी; जल बढ़ने पर हमारी गुफा के समीप ही बहने लगेगी

verses.sloka: प्राग् उदक् प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति ।पश्चात् च एव उन्नता सौम्य निवाते अयम् भविष्यति ॥४-२७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: prāg udak pravaṇe deśe guhā sādhu bhaviṣyati ।paścāt ca eva unnatā saumya nivāte ayam bhaviṣyati ॥4-27-12॥

translations.english: 'O goodnatured Lakshmana the descending path on the northeastern side of the cave and elevation on the the west is auspicious.This place is protected from rain water and from strong wind.
translations.hindi: इस गुफा के ईशानकोण की भूमि नीची है ओर इसका पिछला भाग ऊँचा है । इस लिए हमें यहाँ हवा का डर नहीं रहेगा अर्थांत हवा के मोकों से वृष्टिजल भी. न आवेगा

verses.sloka: गुहा द्वारे च सौमित्रे शिला सम तला शिवा ।कृष्णा च एव आयता चैव भिन्न अंजन चय उपममा ॥४-२७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: guhā dvāre ca saumitre śilā sama talā śivā ।kṛṣṇā ca eva āyatā caiva bhinna aṁjana caya upamamā ॥4-27-13॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana at the entrance of the cave is a rock, smooth and large, resembling a heap of shining collyrium.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! गुफा के द्वार पर जो शिला है| वह समतल आर चिकनी तथा लंबी चौड़ी होने से यहाँ रहने वालों के लिए, कल्याणदाधिनी है और अंजन की तरह काली है

verses.sloka: गिरि शृंगम् इदम् तात पश्य च उत्तरतः सुभम् ।भिन्न अंजन चय आकारम् अंभोधरम् इव उदितम् ॥४-२७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: giri śṛṁgam idam tāta paśya ca uttarataḥ subham ।bhinna aṁjana caya ākāram aṁbhodharam iva uditam ॥4-27-14॥

translations.english: 'O dear look at the mountain peak in the north rising like a raincloud.It is auspicious. It resembles a heap of collyrium.
translations.hindi: हे तात! यह देखो उत्तर की ओर इस पर्वत का शिखर अंजन के ढेर की तरह अथवा उमड़े हुए मेघ की तरह देख पड़ता है

verses.sloka: दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिश स्थितम् श्वेतम् इव अंबरम् ।कैलास शिखर प्रख्यम् नाना धातु विराजितम् ॥४-२७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyām api diśa sthitam śvetam iva aṁbaram ।kailāsa śikhara prakhyam nānā dhātu virājitam ॥4-27-15॥

translations.english: 'In the southern direction is a white rock appearing as if it is another mountain. It looks like mount Kailas and is rich with various minerals.
translations.hindi: दक्षिण ओर भा केलास पर्वत के शिखर की तरह ओर श्वेत मेघों के समान एबं अनेक प्रकार की धातुओं से रंगा हुआ, यहद पर्वत शिखर शोभायमान हो रहा है

verses.sloka: प्राचीन वाहिनीम् चैव नदीम् भृशम् अकर्दमम् ।गुहायाः परतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जह्नवीम् इव ॥४-२७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: prācīna vāhinīm caiva nadīm bhṛśam akardamam ।guhāyāḥ parataḥ paśya trikūṭe jahnavīm iva ॥4-27-16॥

translations.english: 'Look at the river flowing towards the east. It has clean water and flows towards the east of the cave and looks like the river Jahnavi flowing on the mount Trikuta. This place looks delightful with the sandalwood, tilaka, sala, tamala, atimukta, padmaka, sarala and asoka trees.
translations.hindi: इस गुफा के झम्रभाग में कीचड़रहित और पूर्व की ओर बहने वाली यह्‌ नदी उसी प्रकार शोभायमान हे, जिस प्रकार त्रिकूट पर्वेत पर गङ्गा शोभायमान हो

verses.sloka: चन्दनैः तिलकैः सालैः तमालैः अतिमुक्तकैः ।पद्मकैः सरलैः चैव अशोकैः चैव शोभितम् ॥४-२७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: candanaiḥ tilakaiḥ sālaiḥ tamālaiḥ atimuktakaiḥ ।padmakaiḥ saralaiḥ caiva aśokaiḥ caiva śobhitam ॥4-27-17॥

translations.english: 'Look at the river flowing towards the east. It has clean water and flows towards the east of the cave and looks like the river Jahnavi flowing on the mount Trikuta. This place looks delightful with the sandalwood, tilaka, sala, tamala, atimukta, padmaka, sarala and asoka trees.
translations.hindi: इसके तटबती ओर तरह तरह के चम्पा, तिलक, तांड समाल, पौँड्क, पक, पीत देवदार, अशोक, बानी नास चेंत, तिमिर वृक्त, मोलसरी, केबड़ा; {हन्ताल, तिमिश और अमलः तासादि वृक्ष, जो इसीके जल से उत्पन्न हुए हैं, इस नदी की वैसी शोभा बढ़ा रहे हैं, जैसे वस्राभूषण स्त्री की शोभा बढ़ाते हैं

verses.sloka: वानीरैः तिमिदैः चैव वकुलैः केतकैः अपि ।हिन्तालैः तिनिशैः नीपैः वेतसैः कृतमालकैः ॥४-२७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: vānīraiḥ timidaiḥ caiva vakulaiḥ ketakaiḥ api ।hintālaiḥ tiniśaiḥ nīpaiḥ vetasaiḥ kṛtamālakaiḥ ॥4-27-18॥

translations.english: 'See the different kinds of trees like canes timida, vakula, ketaka, hintala, tinisa, kadamba, dhava, krutamalaka, betasa grown here and there on the bank (of the river), which looks beautiful like a woman decorated with clothes and ornaments.

verses.sloka: तीरजैः शोभिता भाति नाना रूपैः ततः ततः ।वसन आभरण उपेत प्रमद एव अभ्यलंकृता ॥४-२७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tīrajaiḥ śobhitā bhāti nānā rūpaiḥ tataḥ tataḥ ।vasana ābharaṇa upeta pramada eva abhyalaṁkṛtā ॥4-27-19॥

translations.english: 'See the different kinds of trees like canes timida, vakula, ketaka, hintala, tinisa, kadamba, dhava, krutamalaka, betasa grown here and there on the bank (of the river), which looks beautiful like a woman decorated with clothes and ornaments.

verses.sloka: शतशः पक्षि सन्घैः च नाना नाद विनादिता ।एकैकम् अनुरक्तैः च चक्रवाकैः अलंकृता ॥४-२७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: śataśaḥ pakṣi sanghaiḥ ca nānā nāda vināditā ।ekaikam anuraktaiḥ ca cakravākaiḥ alaṁkṛtā ॥4-27-20॥

translations.english: 'The river flocked with hundreds of birds chirping melodious notes and specially the chakravaka birds which are clinging to their mates in great love are moving in pairs.The river has lovely sandy banks filled with swans and sarasa birds. The river appears as though a young woman decked all over is laughing.
translations.hindi: सैकड़ों पक्षियों के झुण्डों की तरह तरह की बोलियाँ सुनाई प ड़ती हैं और परस्पर अनुराग-युक्त चकवा चकई से यह भूषित है

verses.sloka: पुलिनैः अति रम्यैः च हंस सारस सेविता ।प्रहसंती इव भाति एषा नारी रत्न विभूषिता ॥४-२७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: pulinaiḥ ati ramyaiḥ ca haṁsa sārasa sevitā ।prahasaṁtī iva bhāti eṣā nārī ratna vibhūṣitā ॥4-27-21॥

translations.english: 'The river flocked with hundreds of birds chirping melodious notes and specially the chakravaka birds which are clinging to their mates in great love are moving in pairs.The river has lovely sandy banks filled with swans and sarasa birds. The river appears as though a young woman decked all over is laughing.
translations.hindi: अति रमणीय तीर देशों से शोभित तथा हंस और सारसः पक्षियों से सेवित होने के कारण यह नदी अनेक, प्रकार के रत्न- जटित आभूपणों से विभूषित स्त्री की तरह हँसती हुई सी जान पड़ती है

verses.sloka: क्वचित् नीलोत्पलैः च्छन्न भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित् ।क्वचित् भाति शुक्लैः च दिव्यैः कुमुद कुड्मलैः ॥४-२७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: kvacit nīlotpalaiḥ cchanna bhāti raktotpalaiḥ kvacit ।kvacit bhāti śuklaiḥ ca divyaiḥ kumuda kuḍmalaiḥ ॥4-27-22॥

translations.english: 'The river looks wonderful with lotuses now blue, now red and now white.
translations.hindi: » इस नदी में कहीं नीले रंग के, कहीं लाल रंग के कमले के फूल फूल रहे हें और कहीं दिव्य सफेद रंग की कुमुदनी की कलियाँ इसकी शोभा बढ़ा रही हैं

verses.sloka: पारिप्लव शतैः जुष्टा बर्हि क्रौन्च विनादिता ।रमणिया नदी सौम्य मुनि संघ निषेविता ॥४-२७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: pāriplava śataiḥ juṣṭā barhi kraunca vināditā ।ramaṇiyā nadī saumya muni saṁgha niṣevitā ॥4-27-23॥

translations.english: 'This placid river water is haunted by waterbirds, peacocks and kraunchas, It is inhabited by groups of sages.
translations.hindi: सैकड़ों जलपची, मयूर और क्रौंच इसके तट पर बोल रहे हैं। इस सुन्दर रमणीय नदी के तट पर ऋषिगण भी वास करते ह

verses.sloka: पश्य चंदन वृक्षाणाम् पंक्ती सुरुचिरा इव ।ककुभानम् च दृश्यन्ते मनसा इव उदिताः समम् ॥४-२७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: paśya caṁdana vṛkṣāṇām paṁktī surucirā iva ।kakubhānam ca dṛśyante manasā iva uditāḥ samam ॥4-27-24॥

translations.english: 'See the uniform rows of sandalwood trees, it looks as though they are arranged together imaginatively.
translations.hindi: देखो चन्दन के वृक्षों की पंक्ति ऐसी जान पड़ती हे, मानो ' माला गू'थी हुई हो और अजुन वृक्षों की पंक्तियाँ ऐसी देख पड़ती हैं मानों मन के सङ्कल्प से उगी हों अर्थात्‌ जैसा किसी ने मन में चाहा हो वेसे ही एक पंक्ति में लगी हों अथवा किसी की लगाइ इई हों

verses.sloka: अहो सुरमणीयो अयम् देशः शत्रु निषूदन ।दृढम् रंस्याव सौमित्रे साधु अत्र निवसावहे ॥४-२७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: aho suramaṇīyo ayam deśaḥ śatru niṣūdana ।dṛḍham raṁsyāva saumitre sādhu atra nivasāvahe ॥4-27-25॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri destroyer of enemies this place is most enchanting. Surely we will reside here sporting in joy .

verses.sloka: इतः च न अति दूरे सा किष्किंधा चित्र कानना ।सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या भविष्यति नृपात्मज ॥४-२७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: itaḥ ca na ati dūre sā kiṣkiṁdhā citra kānanā ।sugrīvasya purī ramyā bhaviṣyati nṛpātmaja ॥4-27-26॥

translations.english: 'O prince Sugriva's delightful city of Kishkinda with wonderful forest around is not far from here.
translations.hindi: कपिबर सुग्रीव अपनी भार्या , राज्य और महती राज्यलरमी' श्राप कर के, अपने, मित्रों के साथ आनन्द मनाता होगा ॥२म॥ ३त्युक्त्वा' न्यवसत्तत्र राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः । बहुदृश्यद्रीकुञ्जे तस्मिन्‌ प्रखवणे गिरौ

verses.sloka: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः श्रूयते जयताम् वर ।नदताम् वानराणाम् च मृदंग आडंबरैः सह ॥४-२७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: gīta vāditra nirghoṣaḥ śrūyate jayatām vara ।nadatām vānarāṇām ca mṛdaṁga āḍaṁbaraiḥ saha ॥4-27-27॥

translations.english: 'O hero among the victorious, the sounds of vocal and instrumental music, the beating of drums and shrieking of monkeys are heard (from here).
translations.hindi: हवे विजयिश्रेष्ठ ! देखो, यहाँ से. गाने बजाने का शब्द ओर बानरों का गर्जन तजन, सदर की गमक में मिल कर, सुनाई वड्ता है

verses.sloka: लब्ध्वा भार्याम् कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यम् सुहृत् वृतः ।ध्रुवम् नंदति सुग्रीवः संप्राप्य महतीम् श्रियम् ॥४-२७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: labdhvā bhāryām kapivaraḥ prāpya rājyam suhṛt vṛtaḥ ।dhruvam naṁdati sugrīvaḥ saṁprāpya mahatīm śriyam ॥4-27-28॥

translations.english: 'Having obtained his wife, his kingdom and attained prosperity the monkey chief, Sugriva will be surely enjoying the company of friends and relatives'.

verses.sloka: इति उक्त्वा न्यवसत् तत्र राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः ।बहु दृश्य दरी कुंजे तस्मिन् प्रस्रवणे गिरौ ॥४-२७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktvā nyavasat tatra rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।bahu dṛśya darī kuṁje tasmin prasravaṇe girau ॥4-27-29॥

translations.english: Having said so, Rama resided with Lakshmana on the Prasvarana mountain with many beautiful caverns and shrubs of vines.

verses.sloka: सुसुखे हि बहु द्रव्ये तस्मिन् हि धरणी धरे ।वसतः तस्य रामस्य रतिः अल्पा अपि न अभवत् ॥४-२७-३०॥
verses.transliteration: susukhe hi bahu dravye tasmin hi dharaṇī dhare ।vasataḥ tasya rāmasya ratiḥ alpā api na abhavat ॥4-27-30॥

translations.english: Though Rama was residing in comfort on the mountain richly endowed with many pleasant things, he experienced little happiness.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि उस पर्वत पर सब प्रकार'का सुपास था, बहुत से पुष्प फलादि थे, तथापि श्रीरामचन्द्र का मन वहाँ रहने से प्रसन्न न हुआ

verses.sloka: हृताम् हि भार्याम् स्मरतः प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम् ।उदय अभ्युदितम् दृष्ट्वा शशांकम् च विशेषतः ॥४-२७-३१॥
verses.transliteration: hṛtām hi bhāryām smarataḥ prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm ।udaya abhyuditam dṛṣṭvā śaśāṁkam ca viśeṣataḥ ॥4-27-31॥

translations.english: Specially with the rising Moon in the east, he remembered his abuducted wife who was dearer to him than his life.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जब वे प्राण से भी अधिक प्यारी और हरी हुई सीता स्मरण करते और जब वे विशेष कर उदयाचल पर उदित होते र हुए चन्द्रमा को देखते

verses.sloka: आविवेश न तम् निद्रा निशासु शयनम् गतम् ।तत् समुत्थेन शोकेन बाष्प उपहत चेतसम् ॥४-२७-३२॥
verses.transliteration: āviveśa na tam nidrā niśāsu śayanam gatam ।tat samutthena śokena bāṣpa upahata cetasam ॥4-27-32॥

translations.english: As Rama lay in bed, at night, his grief rose and choked him with tears.
translations.hindi: ड ~ˆ 7 दरद अहूपुपफलादिषने । (गो ०) १ 'बहुद्रव्ये-- बहुपुष्पफला दिघने । (गों०) लब पे औरामचन्द्र जी सीता फे वियोगजनित शोक से आँसू बहते र हतबुद्धि हो जाते थे तथा रात में उनको बिस्तरे पर जैटने पर भी नींद नहीं आती थी

verses.sloka: तम् शोचमानम् काकुत्स्थम् नित्यम् शोक परायणम् ।तुल्य दुःखो अब्रवीद् भ्राता लक्ष्मणो अनुनयम् वचः ॥४-२७-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tam śocamānam kākutstham nityam śoka parāyaṇam ।tulya duḥkho abravīd bhrātā lakṣmaṇo anunayam vacaḥ ॥4-27-33॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama worried and engrossed in endless sorrow, his brother Lakshmana who was equally sad spoke these words of consolation:
translations.hindi: सदेव शोकान्चित श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को शोकाकुल देख, उन्हीं की तरह शोकाकुल लद्मण जी ने श्रोरामचन्द्र जो से नम्रता-पूबक यह्‌ बचन कहे

verses.sloka: अलम् वीर व्यथाम् गत्वा न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि ।शोचतो हि अवसीदन्ति सर्व अर्था विदितम् हि ते ॥४-२७-३४॥
verses.transliteration: alam vīra vyathām gatvā na tvam śocitum arhasi ।śocato hi avasīdanti sarva arthā viditam hi te ॥4-27-34॥

translations.english: 'O heroic one, you know one who broods fails to achieve his objective. So do not brood.
translations.hindi: हे वीर ! आप व्यथित हो शोकाकुक्ञ न हों क्योंकि आप सब जानते ही हैँ कि, शोक करने बाले लाग सदा कष्ट ही पाया करते हैं

verses.sloka: भवान् क्रिया परो लोके भवान् देव परायणः ।आस्तिको धर्म शीलः च व्यवसायी च राघव ॥४-२७-३५॥
verses.transliteration: bhavān kriyā paro loke bhavān deva parāyaṇaḥ ।āstiko dharma śīlaḥ ca vyavasāyī ca rāghava ॥4-27-35॥

translations.english: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.

verses.sloka: न हि अव्यवसितः शत्रुम् राक्षसम् तम् विशेषतः ।समर्थः त्वम् रणे हन्तुम् विक्रमैः जिह्म कारिणम् ॥४-२७-३६॥
verses.transliteration: na hi avyavasitaḥ śatrum rākṣasam tam viśeṣataḥ ।samarthaḥ tvam raṇe hantum vikramaiḥ jihma kāriṇam ॥4-27-36॥

translations.english: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.
translations.hindi: शोक न करने का. कारण बतलाते हुए लक्ष्मण जी कहते हैं कि बुदा अखिलभुवनवासियो की क्रियाओं के प्रवतंक हैं ओर देव ताओं को तृप्ति करने वालों के आश्रयस्थल भी आप ही हें । शिरो ( शरोमशिटीका के हाला 2: हे राघव ! आप आस्तिक हॅ, धम्रेंनुष्ठानतत्पर हैं ओर उद्यमी हैं ।,३४।। न हन्यवसितः शत्रुं राक्षसं तं विशेषत; । ® पाठान्तरे? विहितं”? | समयस्ल रणे हन्तु विक्रमैजिहाका रिणय्‌

verses.sloka: समुन्मूलय शोकम् त्वम् व्यवसायम् स्थिरी कुरु ।ततः सपरिवारम् तम् राक्षसम् हन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥४-२७-३७॥
verses.transliteration: samunmūlaya śokam tvam vyavasāyam sthirī kuru ।tataḥ saparivāram tam rākṣasam hantum arhasi ॥4-27-37॥

translations.english: 'Root out sorrow. Be daring. Be firm in resolve. (Only) then can you destroy the demon and his family.

verses.sloka: पृथिवीम् अपि काकुत्स्थ ससागर वन अचलाम् ।परिवर्तयितुम् शक्तः किम् पुनः तम् हि रावणम् ॥४-२७-३८॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīm api kākutstha sasāgara vana acalām ।parivartayitum śaktaḥ kim punaḥ tam hi rāvaṇam ॥4-27-38॥

translations.english: 'O Kakutstha, you can turn the earth with its oceans, forests and mountains, what to speak of Ravana.
translations.hindi: हे राम आप तो ! सागर, वन और पवर्तो सहित इस प्रथिवी: को उलट सकते हैं ! रावण की तो बात ही क्या है

verses.sloka: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट् कालो अयम् आगतः ।ततः स राष्ट्रम् स गणाम् रावणम् तम् वधिष्यसि ॥४-२७-३९॥
verses.transliteration: śarat kālam pratīkṣasva prāvṛṭ kālo ayam āgataḥ ।tataḥ sa rāṣṭram sa gaṇām rāvaṇam tam vadhiṣyasi ॥4-27-39॥

translations.english: 'This is the rainy season.Wait for autumn.Thereafter you will destroy Ravana along with his kingdom and clan.

verses.sloka: अहम् तु खलु ते वीर्यम् प्रसुप्तम् प्रतिबोधये ।दीप्तैः आहुतिभिः काले भस्म चन्नम् इव अनलम् ॥४-२७-४०॥
verses.transliteration: aham tu khalu te vīryam prasuptam pratibodhaye ।dīptaiḥ āhutibhiḥ kāle bhasma cannam iva analam ॥4-27-40॥

translations.english: 'I am only awakening your dormant valour as one would kindle the fire covered with ashes by making offerings.'
translations.hindi: रख से ढकी हुई आग को आहुति दे कर प्रज्ज्वलित करने को तरह आपके सोते हुए पराक्रम को में जगाता हूँ

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य हि तद् वाक्यम् प्रतिपूज्य हितम् शुभम् ।राघवः सुहृदम् स्निग्धम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-२७-४१॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya hi tad vākyam pratipūjya hitam śubham ।rāghavaḥ suhṛdam snigdham idam vacanam abravīt ॥4-27-41॥

translations.english: On hearing the good counsel and auspicious words of Lakshmana, Rama spoke these loving and warm words:

verses.sloka: वाच्यम् यद् अनुरक्तेन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च ।सत्य विक्रम युक्तेन तद् उक्तम् लक्ष्मण त्वया ॥४-२७-४२॥
verses.transliteration: vācyam yad anuraktena snigdhena ca hitena ca ।satya vikrama yuktena tad uktam lakṣmaṇa tvayā ॥4-27-42॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana you have spoken the words of an affectionate and friendly counsellor of proven valour.

verses.sloka: एष शोकः परित्यक्तः सर्व कार्य अवसादकः ।विक्रमेषु अप्रतिहतम् तेजः प्रोत्साहयामि अहम् ॥४-२७-४३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa śokaḥ parityaktaḥ sarva kārya avasādakaḥ ।vikrameṣu apratihatam tejaḥ protsāhayāmi aham ॥4-27-43॥

translations.english: 'This sorrow which dampens one's daring spirit is given up. I shall now resort to such undaunted valour during my heroic exploits.
translations.hindi: यह लो, मैंने समस्त कार्यो के विनाश करने वाले शोक को त्याग दिया । अब में अपने पराक्रम सम्बन्धी दुराधष तेज को प्रोस्साहित करता हूँ

verses.sloka: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितो अस्मि वचने तव ।सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अनुपालयन् ॥४-२७-४४॥
verses.transliteration: śarat kālam pratīkṣiṣye sthito asmi vacane tava ।sugrīvasya nadīnām ca prasādam anupālayan ॥4-27-44॥

translations.english: 'I will wait for autumn. I will stick to your advice while I wait until Sugriva and the rivers are pleased (with moderate flow of water.)

verses.sloka: उपकारेण विरः तु प्रतिकारेण युज्यते ।अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्ववताम् मनः ॥४-२७-४५॥
verses.transliteration: upakāreṇa viraḥ tu pratikāreṇa yujyate ।akṛtajño apratikṛto hanti satvavatām manaḥ ॥4-27-45॥

translations.english: A hero requites a benefit with a return of service; but the ungrateful one who repays no favour breaks the heart of the noble-spirited.
translations.hindi: जो बीर पुरुष होते हैं, वे अपने उपकारी पुरुष क्रा अवश्य कते ही हैं । वे यदि कृतप्न हो जॉय और उपकार को न मान, प्रत्युपकार न करें; तो ऐसा करने बालों की ओर ने अन फट जाता (है.

verses.sloka: तत् एव युक्तम् प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणःकृत अंजलि तत् प्रतिपूजय भाषितम् ।उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम् ॥४-२७-४६॥
verses.transliteration: tat eva yuktam praṇidhāya lakṣmaṇaḥkṛta aṁjali tat pratipūjaya bhāṣitam ।uvāca rāmam svabhirāma darśanampradarśayan darśanam ātmanaḥ śubham ॥4-27-46॥

translations.english: Then Lakshmana reflected upon the words of Rama thoughtfully. He honoured his brother's words by receiving his advice with folded hands and spoke to his handsome brother giving out his own views:
translations.hindi: फिर लस जी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के युक्तियुक्त वचन सुन और उनकी प्रशंसा कर, हाथ जोड़ कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सम्मुख हो, यह बोले

verses.sloka: यथोक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिरात् तु वानर ।शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः ॥४-२७-४७॥
verses.transliteration: yathoktam etat tava sarvam īpsitamnarendra kartā na cirāt tu vānara ।śarat pratīkṣaḥ kṣamatām imam bhavānjala prapātam ripu nigrahe dhṛtaḥ ॥4-27-47॥

translations.english: 'O lord of men, your desire will be fulfilled soon. Be determined to fight the enemy while waiting for autumn. Forgive this rainy season (and its water that obstructs).
translations.hindi: है नरेन्द्र ! आप जो कुछ कहते हैं सो सव ठीक है और में भी यही सममवा हूँ कि, वानरवर सुप्रीब शीघ्र ही सहायता करने को उद्यत होंगे । आप वर्षाकाल व्यतीत करते हुए शरत्काल की प्रतीक्षा कीजिए । वघांकाल समाप्त होने पर, आप अपने शत्रु के निग्रह करने में दत्तचित्त होना

verses.sloka: नियम्य कोपम् प्रतिपाल्यताम् शरत्क्षमस्व मासाम् चतुरो मया सह ।वस अचले अस्मिन् मृग राज सेवितेसंवर्तयन् शत्रु वधे समर्थः ॥४-२७-४८॥
verses.transliteration: niyamya kopam pratipālyatām śaratkṣamasva māsām caturo mayā saha ।vasa acale asmin mṛga rāja sevitesaṁvartayan śatru vadhe samarthaḥ ॥4-27-48॥

translations.english: 'Control your anger and wait for autumn. Pardon these (intervening) four months (which put a halt on your wareffort). Stay with me on this mountain infested with lions. Brace up to kill the enemy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
